value.rationale: This solves a naturally constrained optimal measurement-design problem: exactly eight samples (the known dimension-three absolute minimum) arranged in two concentric regular squares. It gives a complete and sharp criterion for when this geometry succeeds, concrete successful Gaussian-integer lattice positions, the entire lifted singular spectrum, and a quantitative stability bound. The radial and angular obstructions are genuine and explicit; it is more than a numerical rank check or a restatement of generic existence. The exact finite-dimensional structural classification and spectrum support reproducible low-complexity phaseless interpolation.
